about_the_game:
This is a placement game located at the bottom of the screen that won't interfere with your daily study and work. Research technologies, grow crops, automate tasks, explore maps, utilize various machines to craft items, and defend against monsters. With just you and a dog, conquer the apocalypse!

Planting crops:

Plant various crops. After using the seeds, plant them on your newly reclaimed farmland. This is an important source of food.

Building an electrical system:

Shelters and drones or robots used for automation need energy supplies. Build generators and charging facilities to power them!

Let Robots Work For You:

Deploy cute drones or robots to assist in resource collection, combat, and map exploration, etc. More machines are waiting for you to unlock!

Construction and production:

Collect resources from the wild and make all kinds of necessary items through equipment to add bricks and tiles to the shelter!

Defend against attacks:

As the shelter develops, it will attract monsters to attack. Upgrade your drone and unlock more powerful attacks!

Map Exploration:

Build radars, explore maps, and dispatch exploration drones to collect more resources!

More buildings and gameplay features await your discovery!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E6320 (2*1866) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 3000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
